notes.title: Update 1.3 notes
notes.content: Hi all! The team have been working hard to resolve a major issues some of you were experiencing. Animation speed was changed so now it fits player movement, health bar UI was added, general game stability was fixed. Also game difficulty level was increased. We'd like to thank you for being patient. Wish you a pleasant playing.
